description: This is a PHP source file defining a 'HomeController' class that handles various AJAX actions related to editing, saving, and displaying fields within the SuiteCRM application. The controller processes requests for editing HTML fields, saving fields, retrieving display values, validation rules, and generating relate field JavaScript for the 'Home' module.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: Controller class extending SugarController to handle specific AJAX actions for the Home module in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: action_getEditFieldHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for editing a specific field in the current module.

methods.name: action_saveHTMLField
methods.description: Saves the HTML content of a specific field for the current module.

methods.name: action_getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves and displays the display value of a specific field from a bean.

methods.name: action_getValidationRules
methods.description: Returns validation rules for a specific field, including labels and types.

methods.name: action_getRelateFieldJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for relate field quick search in the edit view.
